moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio rubber-band, written here): A cursor grabs a pill and pulls it x +105 px with scaleX 1 → 1.8 (scaleY = 1/scaleX) over 380 ms power2.inOut; on release x and scaleX return by one spring (k 300, d 11): scaleX dips to ~0.72 then 1, x settles at a new rest +37 px from the start, ~520 ms. (Demo px.) The spring overshoots 35 %; the site returns the pill to its first slot in 400 ms at 2000 ms. Params: pull: quãng kéo (105 px) · stretch (1.8) · spring (k 300, d 11) · rest: chỗ nghỉ mới (+37 px). Stretched toward the pull from its left end; on release one spring brings the stretch back (dipping to about 0.72) and carries it to a new rest.
